title: The Warning on the Ring
description:
Some bargains are not meant to be undone. The Seven Curses route is available to those who deliberately want a harsher game, not a rite of passage for every adventurer.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: Nothing in the main campaign requires this ring. Choosing not to wear it will not close other quests.

objectives.name: Read the warning; no curse is activated by this quest
